## Description

Programmatically reducing a face tolerance below the actual geometric defect, then running `ShapeFix`, makes the fix algorithm interpret coincident vertex tolerance balls as separate vertices, producing vertex/vertex intersection diagnostics.

## Reproducer recipe

Set face tolerance to `1e-9` on a face whose actual edge gap is `1e-5`, then `ShapeFix_Shape::Perform`.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — recompute tolerance from current geometry rather than trusting user-set sub-resolution tolerance.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `heal`
